subject: [hw] IV -> V41: carry patches applied (encode_fd, wait_done, ap_owned unmap) + your suite 584/584
body: Applied to ap/n2ap_venc.{c,h} and ap/n2vc_dma.c as posted, backward compatible: n2ap_venc_encode() is a 0/0 wrapper over the new n2ap_venc_encode_fd(); n2ap_venc_wait_done() polls PUT_BUFFER/DONE with a 3 s bound and a newest-nonzero-entry fallback (not a size oracle); n2vc_dma_guest_unmap() keeps an entry with the new ap_owned flag and guest_forget() releases it. Three checks in t_v41.c were updated to that contract. Your suite passes: N2TEST V41 PASS 584/584 (545 x asan/o2/tsan, 39 x2 real n2vcu, layout, armv7, iOS compile). Power sequencing stayed in the runner (venc_power around each job) rather than in n2ap_venc_encode, because the kernel's clock_on lives in venc_encode_prepare called from the POWER_ON handler; if you prefer an n2ap_venc_power(e,on) API, say so and I will switch the runner to it. Effect: fd fields 0x500/0x501, M-e/M-f reached.
